description: Event-driven notification and communication workflow for telco network operations change calendar, covering impact assessment, stakeholder targeting, multi-channel notifications, acknowledgements, and escalation.

change_id.description: Unique identifier of the planned, in-progress, or completed network change in the change calendar.

notification_campaign_id.description: Identifier representing a specific notification campaign associated with one or more changes.

notification_batch_id.description: Identifier for a batch of notifications (e.g., all SMS/Email sent to a specific stakeholder segment in one run).

contact_list_id.description: Identifier of a pre-defined or dynamically generated list of stakeholder contacts.

stakeholder_segment_id.description: Identifier for a logical stakeholder segment (e.g., enterprise customers in a region, internal NOC team).

channel_subscription_id.description: Identifier for a stakeholder's subscription preferences to specific notification channels and event types.

escalation_policy_id.description: Identifier of an escalation policy defining how unacknowledged or failed notifications are escalated.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier used to trace an event or notification lifecycle across systems.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: analyze_change_impact_for_notifications
functions.description: Analyze a scheduled network change and derive notification impact, stakeholder segments, and recommended communication plan.

change_id.description: Identifier of the change to analyze.

change_metadata.description: Additional metadata about the change, used if the caller wants to override or augment calendar data.

impact_scope.description: Explicit impact scoping to refine who should be notified.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier for tracing this impact analysis.

functions.returns: Recommended stakeholder segments, estimated impact, and initial notification strategy for the change.

functions.name: build_stakeholder_segments
functions.description: Create or update stakeholder segments based on impact analysis and predefined rules.

change_id.description: Change for which stakeholder segments are being built.

base_segments.description: Existing predefined segments to start from.

dynamic_rules.description: Dynamic rules to build segments from metadata and inventory.

field.description: Field path, e.g., customer.region or service.type.

output_segment.description: Properties of the resulting stakeholder segment.

auto_expire_after.description: ISO 8601 duration after which the segment is auto-archived, e.g., 'P7D'.

functions.returns: Created or updated stakeholder_segment_id and summary of included contacts.

functions.name: generate_contact_list_from_segments
functions.description: Generate a concrete contact list from one or more stakeholder segments, applying channel preferences and deduplication.

stakeholder_segments.description: Segments that will be merged into a contact list.

priority.description: Priority for resolving conflicts and deduplication.

channel_filters.description: Channel-level filters to constrain generated contacts.

min_contact_reliability_score.description: Exclude contacts with lower reliability scores.

label.description: Human-readable label for the generated contact list.

functions.returns: Generated contact_list_id with counts per channel and deduplication summary.

functions.name: define_notification_campaign
functions.description: Create a notification campaign for one or more changes, defining content variants, timing, and channels.

change_ids.description: List of change_ids that this campaign covers.

primary_contact_list_id.description: Main contact list associated with this campaign.

channels.description: Notification channels and their specific configuration.

timing.description: Timing rules for this channel within the campaign.

relative_offset_minutes.description: Offset relative to change start_time; negative for before, positive for after.

acknowledgement_policy.description: Rules regarding acknowledgement requirements and SLAs.

escalation_policy_id.description: Escalation policy to use if acknowledgements or deliveries fail.

functions.returns: Created notification_campaign_id and campaign configuration summary.

functions.name: schedule_notification_batches
functions.description: Schedule concrete notification batches for a campaign based on timing rules and contact list size.

contact_list_id.description: Contact list to be used for scheduling.

batching_strategy.description: How to slice the contact list into batches.

scheduling_constraints.description: Constraints on when notifications can be sent.

quiet_hours.description: Optional override of quiet hours by region.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate batch creation without persisting.

functions.returns: List of scheduled notification_batch_ids, planned send times, and optionally simulated statistics for dry run.

functions.name: trigger_notification_batch_send
functions.description: Trigger sending of a specific notification batch, either at scheduled time or manually.

override_send_time.description: Override the planned send time; if in the past or null, send immediately subject to constraints.

test_mode.description: Optional test mode to limit sending to test recipients.

functions.returns: Batch send initiation status, effective send time, and summary of targeted contacts per channel.

functions.name: get_notification_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and delivery metrics for campaigns, batches, or individual recipients.

scope.description: Level of granularity for status retrieval.

functions.returns: Status details, metrics, and optionally event logs at the requested scope.

functions.name: record_notification_delivery_event
functions.description: Ingest delivery or failure events from external notification providers to update internal status.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID linking the provider event to the original notification.

provider.description: Notification provider name (e.g., Twilio, SendGrid, internal_gateway).

functions.returns: Updated notification status for the affected recipient and correlation.

functions.name: record_change_acknowledgement
functions.description: Record an acknowledgement from a stakeholder that they have received and understood the change notification.
functions.returns: Acknowledgement record status and whether escalation or follow-up is required.

functions.name: auto_escalate_unacknowledged_notifications
functions.description: Automatically escalate unacknowledged or failed notifications according to an escalation policy.

notification_campaign_id.description: Campaign for which to run escalation.

escalation_policy_id.description: Override escalation policy; if not provided, uses campaign default.

dry_run.description: If true, only calculate which notifications would be escalated.

filters.description: Additional filters to narrow candidates for escalation.

functions.returns: List of customers and notifications escalated (or to be escalated in dry run), plus any new escalation notification_campaign_ids created.

functions.name: retry_failed_notification_batch
functions.description: Retry sending failed or undelivered notifications from a specific batch, with optional modifications.

notification_batch_id.description: Original batch from which failed notifications will be retried.

channel_overrides.description: Optional overrides to change channels on retry.

condition.description: Condition determining when to apply the override.

functions.returns: New notification_batch_id for the retry operation and summary of recipients included.

functions.name: cancel_or_modify_notification_campaign
functions.description: Cancel an upcoming or in-progress notification campaign, or modify its future batches and content.

modify_options.description: Options for modifying future batches when operation is modify_future_batches.

relative_offset_adjustment_minutes.description: Number of minutes to shift all future batches (positive or negative).

absolute_reschedule_after.description: Reschedule all unsent batches after this timestamp.

update_content.description: Optional new content templates for future notifications.

target_batches.description: Optional list of specific batches to which modifications apply; if omitted, all future batches.

functions.returns: Updated campaign state, list of affected batches, and any cancellations performed.

functions.name: upsert_channel_subscription_preferences
functions.description: Create or update stakeholder channel subscription and preference profiles for future change notifications.

customer_id.description: Customer or internal stakeholder whose preferences are updated.

channel_subscription_id.description: Existing subscription profile to update; if omitted, a new one is created.

audit.description: Audit information about who changed the preferences.

updated_by.description: User or system ID performing the update.

functions.returns: channel_subscription_id and the effective merged preferences after the update.

functions.name: search_changes
functions.description: Faceted search across change records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for telco_change_notification_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of change records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_changes_by_status
functions.description: List change records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of change records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_change_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single change record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A change record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_changes
functions.description: Submit a batch of change records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_changes
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many change records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_changes
functions.description: Soft-archive change records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_changes
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of change records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_change_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for change lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_change_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created change event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_change_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a change including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_change_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for telco_change_notification_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_change_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a telco_change_notification_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_change_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled telco_change_notification_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_change_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a telco_change_notification_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_change_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a change prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_change_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a change for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_change_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending change approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_change
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached change to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_change_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a change.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_change_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a change with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_change_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a change and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_change_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a change (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_change_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for telco_change_notification_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_change_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for telco_change_notification_flow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_change_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed telco_change_notification_flow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_change_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active telco_change_notification_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_change_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a change and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
